proposed.explanation: Correct sequence and appropriate key deliverables for each phase. Incorrect sequence; Pre-Design cannot come after Schematic. Completely reversed sequence; Construction Documents cannot precede earlier phases. Deliverables are out of phase (cost estimate in Schematic, not Pre-Design; drawings in Design Dev, not Constr Docs). Correct sequence: Pre-Design (program/feasibility) → Schematic (concepts) → Design Development (systems/engineering) → Construction Documents (complete specifications) → Construction Administration (site verification). Each phase builds on the previous. Architectural design process sequence is strict: Pre-Design → Schematic → Design Dev → Constr Docs → Constr Admin. Each phase has distinct objectives and deliverables. Do not skip phases or reorder them.
